entities.summary: Hildebrando Mendes Costa is a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as a Titular Bishop of Arindela and an Auxuliary Bishop of Aracaju (1981—1986), and later, as a Diocesan Bishop of Estância (1986–2003).
